pyproject.toml:10 requires-python >=3.11. rule_sets.py:239 builds the lock via default_factory=asyncio.Lock, which is a plain constructor call. Since Python 3.10, asyncio.Lock takes no loop argument and does not capture a loop at construction. The one failure case is contended use from two different event loops in one process, which a single-loop server does not produce.
